title: TinRPG
description: With this datapack you'll be able to turn Minecraft into more of an "RPG" type of survival experience, with an ability to upgrade your stats, beginning with nothing.
body:
**NOTE: YOU MUST HAVE OP PERMISSIONS FOR THE DATAPACK TO WORK; YOU WILL NEED TO DO /function rpgupgrade:load AT WORLD CREATION (if played multiplayer, each person needs to do this individually**


With this simple datapack you can turn your Minecraft survival experience in a more "strategic?" where every upgrade is valuable. You can upgrade things such as your health, inventory, attack damage, etc, etc.

This could also be played in multiplayer

The datapack still has some bugs but it's 100% functional. May add more stuff in the future, but for now, enjoy :)
